lyra_vey.name: Lyra Vey
lyra_vey.title: Warden of the Whispering Glade

passive.name: Whisperstep
passive.text: Allies gain 8% Speed while Lyra is alive.

lyra_vey.lore: Last warden of a glade that no longer remembers her name. Lyra speaks to the wind and listens to what it refuses to say.

bramble.name: Bramble
bramble.title: Thorn-Touched Wanderer

passive.name: Rooted
passive.text: Bramble takes 10% less damage while below half health.

bramble.lore: A fox-eared drifter raised by the bramble hedges. She apologizes to every tree she cuts and means it every time.

seraphine.name: Seraphine Ael
seraphine.title: Dawn's Last Ember

passive.name: Dawnkeeper
passive.text: The first healing skill each battle costs no turn energy.

seraphine.lore: The last ember of a sun that set before the world was named. Seraphine carries its warmth in her hands and gives it away freely.

nyx.name: Nyx Vaelora
nyx.title: Queen of the Hollow Moon

passive.name: Hollow Crown
passive.text: Dark skills deal 15% more damage to enemies with a debuff.

nyx.lore: A queen who traded her reflection for a throne. The moon she rules over is a hole in the sky, and it is always full.

coralyn.name: Coralyn Tide
coralyn.title: Song Beneath the Reef

passive.name: Tidecall
passive.text: Healing skills also grant a small shield.

coralyn.lore: Coralyn left the deep reef to learn why the tides kept whispering a name that was not hers. She still hums it when she is afraid.

ignis.name: Ignis Karroth
ignis.title: Crown of Cinders

passive.name: Ashen Wake
passive.text: Critical hits burn the target for 2 turns.

ignis.lore: The last heir of a kingdom that burned itself to keep him warm. Ignis wears its crown of cinders and has never once apologized.

mira_sol.name: Mira Sol
mira_sol.title: Squire of the Golden Gate

passive.name: Hold the Line
passive.text: Allies behind Mira take 6% less damage.

mira_sol.lore: A squire who never got knighted because the kingdom ran out of knights before it ran out of wars. She keeps the oath anyway.

thistle.name: Thistle
thistle.title: Lantern of Small Wishes

passive.name: Small Miracles
passive.text: At the start of battle, grant the team 10 energy.

thistle.lore: A wisp born from a child's wish on a winter night. Thistle collects abandoned wishes in a lantern and lights them when someone needs hope.

vespera.name: Vespera Noct
vespera.title: Velvet Requiem

passive.name: Sanguine Waltz
passive.text: Heals for 20% of all damage dealt.

vespera.lore: Vespera attends every funeral in Nocturne, dressed in white. Nobody has ever seen her leave before the last candle goes out.

arachnia.name: Arachnia Silk
arachnia.title: Weaver of the Quiet Web

passive.name: Patient Weaver
passive.text: Stunned enemies take 20% more damage from Arachnia.

arachnia.lore: Arachne of the eighth strand, who wove a tapestry of every road in Aetheria and then hid the one that leads to her.

terra.name: Terra Rootheart
terra.title: The Mountain That Remembers

passive.name: Deep Roots
passive.text: Terra cannot be moved by knockback and gains 15% Defense.

terra.lore: She was a mountain before she was a woman, and she still dreams in stone. When she speaks, the ground answers first.

kael.name: Kael Ashford
kael.title: Blade Without a Banner
kael.lore: A sellsword who burned his banner and kept the sword. He fights for anyone with coin, and for one person without it.
